name: joshdevbox
description: Free skills, plugins and mods from the channel. One folder per item, each installable on its own.

plugins.name: verify-setup
plugins.description: Interviews you about your project, then writes live-run verification rules into its CLAUDE.md so the agent proves its work instead of claiming it.

plugins.name: ai-briefing
plugins.description: A weekly AI news briefing: searches your topics, keeps only claims two independent sources back, drops duplicates, ranks the rest and writes a dated HTML report linking every source.
